newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Fusion Systems raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Fusion Systems raised.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co raised its rating on shares of Fusion Systems Corp to buy from long term attractive after the company, on Friday, said it expects to report fourth quarter revenues of $18.4 million and earnings between $0.15 and $0.19 a share, well above the range of analysts's estimates.

-- In a statement, analyst Dan Klesken said he raised his 1996 estimate to $0.98 a share from $1.03, and his fiscal 1997 estimate to $1.25 from a previous $1.00. In addition, he established a 1998 estimate of 42.00 a share.
-- Fusion makes photostabilizers and single-wafter ashers that are used in the fabrication of semiconductors.
